name: Beico
bio: Beico is an Argentine DJ and producer whose sound moves through the driving edge of techno and melodic techno. His work is built around high-impact club energy, tension and precision, while retaining the emotional scale that has become central to his identity. With releases connected to labels including Armada, Filth On Acid and Terminal M, Beico continues to develop an international profile through original productions and powerful live sets.

name: Brigado Crew
bio: Formed by Brian Harrison and Martín Kasall, Brigado Crew emerged from Buenos Aires with a sound that connects melodic techno, indie dance and forward-looking electronic music. Their breakthrough “Zulu” reached #1 on Beatport’s Deep House chart, while their catalog has appeared on labels including Diynamic, Stil vor Talent, Tomorrowland Music, Bedrock, Radikon and Toolroom. Their debut album Symbiosis later evolved into their own label and showcase concept, extending the duo’s vision beyond the studio and onto international dancefloors.

name: Deiv Schon
bio: Buenos Aires born and now based in the United States, Deiv Schon approaches the dancefloor through groove, patience and movement. His sets move between house, minimal and indie dance, adapting naturally to the room rather than following a fixed formula. From intimate clubs to open-air gatherings and the Burning Man circuit, his identity is rooted in long-form storytelling, warm low-end and a direct connection with the crowd.

name: Eze Ramirez
bio: Eze Ramirez is a Buenos Aires DJ and producer bringing a forceful, contemporary approach to melodic techno. His productions balance cinematic atmosphere with club-focused drive, while his touring profile has expanded through the United States and Latin America. Recent milestones include a sold-out all-night-long performance at The Bow in Buenos Aires, appearances at Floyd at Space Miami and Community in Los Angeles, and support from leading names across the melodic electronic scene.

name: Igor Marijuan
bio: Based in Ibiza and touring worldwide, Igor Marijuan is a DJ, curator and music director whose sets are guided by the crowd, the moment and the environment. His musical language is rooted in house, deep house and indie dance, delivered with the optimistic energy and human connection that define his performances. Beyond the booth, Igor develops projects that bring music, culture and community together, extending his role from selector to curator and creative connector.

name: Juan Hansen
bio: Juan Hansen is a composer, producer and live electronic artist from Buenos Aires. Rather than approaching electronic music as a conventional DJ set, Hansen builds performances in real time through vocals, instruments and live composition, moving freely between indie electronic, melodic club music and song-driven moments. His career has taken him through Boiler Room, Watergate, Ultra Buenos Aires and Cosquín Rock, while collaborations and remixes have connected his singular live language with a growing international audience.

name: Mario Lui
bio: Caracas-born and San Diego based, Mario Lui brings together deep house, Latin grooves, minimal textures and progressive storytelling. As a co-founder of AMA Sounds, his work is closely connected to community and the underground electronic culture of the American West Coast. His sets favor warmth and progression over quick impact, creating a fluid narrative designed for clubs, open-air spaces and long-form dancefloors.

name: Nico Moon
bio: Argentine-born and Miami-based, Nico Moon is a DJ, producer and event curator whose sound moves through house, deep grooves and indie dance. A resident of RESISTANCE Miami, he has built his profile across clubs and festivals while developing The Hall, his own label and event platform. Recent highlights include consecutive appearances at Lightning in a Bottle, where his sets have helped establish him as an emerging name within the U.S. electronic circuit, alongside performances across Miami, New York, California, Europe and beyond.

name: Noncitizens
bio: Noncitizens bring together afro, indie and melodic influences in a sound shaped for destination events, open-air dancefloors and international rooms. Their identity balances rhythmic warmth with a polished melodic sensibility, creating sets that can move naturally from sunset environments into late-night club energy. With a strong connection to Ibiza and the Rumors orbit, the project continues to expand through international touring and carefully curated appearances.

name: Victoria Whynot
bio: Victoria Whynot is an Argentine DJ and producer from Villa Carlos Paz, Córdoba, whose musical identity connects classic house foundations, Detroit influence and indie dance. Beginning her musical journey at a young age, she developed a club language informed by figures such as Frankie Knuckles, Larry Levan and Kevin Saunderson while building a distinctly contemporary voice. Her international path includes appearances around ADE, Pacha Ibiza, Creamfields, Paradise and Lollapalooza, alongside some of electronic music’s most recognized artists.
